thread:
maria: Auditor asked for a single artifact that ties last quarter's RBAC changes to KMS key rotations and related audit logs. They want control mapping + chain-of-custody for any service-account deprovs and the vuln triage for CVE-2025-0421. Can folks surface where snapshots and logs live?

tyler: timeframe? last quarter = 2025-01-01 -> 2025-03-31?

maria: yes that window. also need any incident correlation where a role change preceded a suspicious token use. auditor wants proofs, not just pointers. :eyes:

tyler: ok. I can pull Splunk and CloudTrail slices. quick Splunk query I use for role-change -> access events:```index=cloudtrail eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=DeleteRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy | transaction userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName startswith=0 endswith=0 maxspan=1h | search (eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=GetObject OR eventName=StartSession) | table _time, userIdentity, eventName, requestParameters, resources```

tyler: I'll export matching events to s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/rbac_kms_correlation.csv and generate a small chain-of-custody manifest.

jordan: KMS rotation logs are in CloudTrail too but we also have CloudKMS audit entries in audit-logs-prod. For envelope rotations we annotate with tag "evidence_id" in the rotation job. Example CloudTrail event:```{ "eventTime": "2025-02-14T03:21:10Z", "eventName": "RotateKey", "requestParameters": {"keyId": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/qlk"}, "userIdentity": {"principalId": "serviceAccount:rotation-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}}```

jordan: I'll pull the rotation job runbook entries (runbook id RB-rot-2025-02) and the rotation job logs from gs://redwood-ops/rotations/2025-02-14/*.log

maria: we also need evidence for service-account deprovisioning timeline tied to the RBAC change. who owned the deprov?

tyler: that was handled by iam-automation on 2025-02-15 for SA svc-ingest-archiver@redwood. We have an export of the deprov job: s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/deprovs.csv (columns: ts, actor, target_sa, ticket_id). Ticket link in ticketing system: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-7821

auditor_jane: Can you provide proof that the rotation used customer-managed keys (CMKs) and that the previous key material wasn't reused? Need the rotation metadata + KMS-envelope fingerprints. Also chain-of-custody for the exported CSVs (who touched them).

maria: yes. CMK usage is in the encryption context on the artifacts; we include keyVersionId and keyFingerprint in the manifest. For custody: we will produce a small signed manifest (GPG sig) listing file sha256, generated_by, and generation_ts.

jordan: adding note: rotation job produces a fingerprint file at gs://redwood-ops/rotations/2025-02-14/fingerprints.json with entries like `{"keyVersion":"1","fingerprint":"abcdef1234..."}`. I'll include that in the bundle.

tyler: For the logs: I'll include a minimal sampling export and the Splunk saved search id: sec_rbac_kms_correlation_q1_2025. For SIEM correlation, I can link the alert ids where session anomalies followed role changes: ALERT-20250215-023, ALERT-20250215-045.

auditor_jane: Good. For the vuln triage we also need the incident timeline showing when the vuln was assigned, when exploit attempts were observed, and remediation. That ties to CVE-2025-0421 you mentioned.

maria: vuln triage timeline: CVE-2025-0421 discovered 2025-01-20 (triage ticket SEC-7700), exploit attempts detected 2025-02-12 (SIEM alerts), patch rolled 2025-02-16, verification 2025-02-18. I'll attach the triage notes and the verification runbook excerpt.

tyler: I'll stitch everything into one evidence bundle: `evidence-2025Q1-rbac-kms-triage.tar.gz` and place it at s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/bundles/evidence-2025Q1-rbac-kms-triage.tar.gz. I'll also upload a signed manifest: evidence-2025Q1-manifest.json.sig

jordan: I'll generate the chain-of-custody entry in our internal vault (ticket hash + s3 path + checksums).

auditor_jane: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can you provide the exact Splunk saved search JSON or the export of search criteria? 2) who has access to the s3 bucket where the bundle will live? auditors need read access for 72 hours.

tyler: 1) saved search config will be exported as `saved_search_sec_rbac_kms_correlation_q1_2025.json` and included in the bundle. 2) s3 bucket redwood-security has a restricted auditor read role we can attach; I'll create a short-lived presigned URL and send in a separate message.

deploy-bot: export job started: export-id=exp-2025Q1-009, status=running

maria: thanks team. Tyler/Jordan please add brief notes on who performed each step (human name or service account) — auditor wants personnel attribution. Try to keep messages minimal in the bundle, auditors prefer concise provenance.

tyler: noted. I'll add `performed_by` fields to the manifest. Presigned URL will be shared via a secure channel.

jordan: done on rotation fingerprints and runbook excerpt, added GCS paths in the bundle manifest.

auditor_jane: Appreciate it. If possible include a short paragraph mapping each evidence file to the SOC2/ISO control IDs (e.g., CC6.1, A.9.2) — that speeds auditor review.

maria: will do. I'll map files to controls in a `control_map.csv` and include it in the bundle. ETA for bundle and manifest: EOD today PST.

tyler: presigned link posted to private audit room when ready. :white_check_mark:
summary: Auditor requested end-to-end evidence tying RBAC changes to KMS rotations and vuln triage for Q1 2025; team coordinated Splunk/CloudTrail exports, rotation fingerprints, deprov exports, and will produce a signed evidence bundle with control mapping for SOC2/ISO review.
